observations: Three-burner gas hob with a black glass surface.
The unit is heavily wrapped in clear plastic film.
Three silver-colored control knobs are located at the bottom right.
Brand 'Magic' is visible in photo 0; 'SK magic' is visible in photo 1.
A model number is visible in the bottom right corner of photo 1.
The burners are covered with white foam padding under the plastic.

claims.evidence: Rarity is a market-dependent subjective claim.
photo 0 and 1 show three burner positions.
The design is a standard built-in hob that can be placed on a surface.
Requires a video of the unit sparking or lighting without a match.

risks.risk: The glass surface may be cracked or heavily scratched under the plastic wrap.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the glass surface with all plastic wrap removed.
risks.if_unproven: as having a cracked or damaged surface

risks.risk: The automatic ignition or burners may not function.
risks.proof: A video showing all three burners being lit using the built-in ignition.

risks.risk: Internal gas leaks or clogged manifolds.
risks.proof: A video showing steady blue flames on all burners at high and low settings.

proof_requests: Photo of the cooker with all plastic wrap and foam removed to inspect the glass and burner heads.
Video showing the ignition clicking and all three burners lit simultaneously.
Photo of the underside of the unit to check the condition of the gas pipes and battery box.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified by brand and model number. It can be priced at its worst-case condition (non-functional/damaged surface) until the plastic is removed and functionality is demonstrated.
